attempted_axis: Find and close the standing 16-INSTRUCTION DEFICIT (T826/O810) that v2 identified as the root cause and left open. RESOLVED. The deficit is 18 target-only `add rX,r30,r29` address rematerialisations (net 16 after our 3 surplus addi/mr/stwx), one before each id-table access. Cause: the TU spelled all 15 table accesses as pointer arithmetic with a cast (`*(s32*)(speech + SPEECH_BOSSROW(n) + idx * 4)`), which lets MWCC's address-PRE synthesise `speech + idx*4` ITSELF and park it in one callee-saved GPR for the whole function. Cure: declare sSpeechNameBuf and the sActiveTrackId block it aliases as ONE record (SpeechBlock: char name[0x40]; u8 pad_40[0x470]; s32 activeTrack[45]; s32 boss[12][8]) and respell every access as an array reference off one base pointer (speech->boss[n][idx], speech->activeTrack[sel], speech->name). All 15 sites converted in one edit per the all-or-nothing rule of claim.law.cached-base-alias-defeats-rematerialized-index-base.

attributes.residual: EXACTLY ONE INSTRUCTION. fndiff --ops: `target-only: (none)  ours-only: -1 mr`, at 0x40. Target forms the record base directly into its callee-saved home (`lis r3,sSpeechNameBuf@ha ; addi r30,r3,sSpeechNameBuf@lo`); ours routes the ADDR16_LO through r0 and pays `mr r26,r0`. This is the P-class ADDR16_LO home copy, and the image-wide census records it by name: claim.law.addr16-lo-home-copy-census-no-source-discriminant.20260831.v1 lists `game/sound/sounds_evt::AudioSetupBossStreams::sSpeechNameBuf::r30` in its 24-instance P roster (and the corrected 40-function roster in claim.law.addrlo-home-copy-class-is-general-temp-and-shadow-coupled.20260901.v1 lists it again), with S=0 over 683-953 opportunities, twelve candidate discriminants measured and falsified, and an explicit STOP-SPENDING-SOURCE-PROBES disposition. It is also WebFrank-INELIGIBLE: ours is exactly one instruction longer, so per claim.law.webfrank-cannot-close-a-count-asymmetric-residual the count-asymmetric residual fails both the recolor-size and permutation-bijection preconditions, and regnorm independently refuses the REGISTER_ONLY label (STRUCTURAL-PRESENT). Everything still scored against us is downstream of that one instruction: regnorm reports a CONSISTENT 7-register permutation (ours->target r25->r28, r26->r30, r27->r29, r28->r26, r29->r27, r30->r31, with r31 split r29/r25 because our build reuses idx's register for idx*4 at `slwi r31,r31,2` where the target writes a fresh `slwi r29,r25,2`), plus 170 branch rows all shifted by exactly 4 bytes. The coloring axis was probed ONCE and is live but unsteerable — see axis_log. PARKED at one instruction with the mechanism named; do not reopen without a positive control demonstrating direct-form ADDR16_LO lowering from a genuinely new mechanism.
